newsitem.title: BOLIVIA: SOCCER-BOLIVIA DROP MORE HOME POINTS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BOLIVIA DROP MORE HOME POINTS.

text.p: Bolivia's fading hopes of reaching the World Cup finals for the second successive time suffered another blow when they were held to a 1-1 draw at home by Chile on Wednesday.
Bolivia, who have a huge home advantage thanks to the high altitude of La Paz 3,600 metres above sea level, have drawn four of their home qualifying matches and won the two others.

Vladimir Soria put Bolivia ahead with a 25-metre shot in the 27th minute but Pedro Gonzalez equalised direct from a free kick on the stroke of halftime to keep alive Chile's hopes of a first appearance in the finals since 1982.
